clue.text: A king with wealth derived from a variety of sources

indicators.note: a variety of the letters of sources means they are mixed into a new order

explanation.surface: A rich monarch whose fortune came from many different places.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a variety of' signals that SOURCES is rearranged; 'derived from' links the definition to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Croesus was the ancient Lydian ruler proverbial for his riches.

clue.text: A villain promises to pay — and with a lot of interest!

parts.note: a cur is a scoundrel
IOUs are written promises to pay a debt

explanation.surface: A rogue signs debts, at high interest rates.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interest' looks financial after the IOUs, but it means inquisitiveness.
explanation.definitionFit: Curious means inquisitive, eager to know.

clue.text: Russian river spectacle that's quite disgusting

parts.note: the Ob is a river in Siberia
a scene is a sight or spectacle

explanation.surface: A Russian river view that is revolting.
explanation.definitionFit: Obscene means offensive, revolting.

clue.text: Attack currency returns

indicators.note: returns means the word for currency is read backwards

parts.note: notes are paper currency

explanation.surface: Money comes back to fight.
explanation.definitionFit: To set on someone is to assault them.

clue.text: Pottery 'having novel article in stock

indicators.note: in places the new and article letters inside the stock word

parts.note: a store is a stock
new means novel
a is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Ceramics shop keeping a new book in stock.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts NEW and A inside STORE.
explanation.definitionFit: Stoneware is dense fired ceramic.

clue.text: See gunmen about in the distance and wonder

indicators.note: in places the gunners and the about-letter inside the distance word

parts.note: a mile is a distance
RA, the Royal Artillery, are gunners
C, for circa, means about

explanation.surface: Someone spots armed men moving far off and marvels at it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts RA (Royal Artillery) and C (circa) inside MILE; 'See' and 'and' are link words.
explanation.definitionFit: A miracle is a marvel, something that inspires amazement.

clue.text: British money invested in some dilapidated Aegean island

indicators.note: invested in means the money letter goes inside the jumbled word
dilapidated suggests the word some is falling apart and rearranged

parts.note: L stands for the pound sterling, from libra

explanation.surface: Pounds sunk into a run-down Greek island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dilapidated' rearranges SOME into MEOS, and 'invested in' puts L inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Melos is a Greek island in the Cyclades, where the Venus de Milo was found.

clue.text: Just rise ought to be arranged

indicators.note: be arranged means the letters of rise ought are put in a new order

explanation.surface: A command that a rising should be organised.
explanation.walkthrough: 'be arranged' rearranges RISE OUGHT; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Righteous means morally upright, fair.

clue.text: A Greek character not favouring Italian wine

parts.note: chi is a letter of the Greek alphabet
anti means against

explanation.surface: A Greek who dislikes the wine of Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: Chianti is a red from Tuscany.

clue.text: Oriental sea-fowl, almost all very long-lived

parts.note: E, east, is oriental
a tern is a seabird

indicators.note: almost means the word all loses its final letter

explanation.surface: Eastern seabirds, nearly all of them, live for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Eternal means everlasting.

clue.text: Right, one's to return to make a meal

parts.note: one is I, and 's stands for is

indicators.note: return here means the first word to is turned back to front

parts.note: the word to taken as written
the second to taken as written

explanation.surface: Someone tells a person to come back home so dinner can be made.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' turns the first 'to' into OT; the second 'to' is kept as it is, giving OT then TO.
explanation.definitionFit: Risotto is an Italian rice dish served as a dinner course.

clue.text: A number burn coal

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty
to ignite is to set burning

explanation.surface: Someone sets fire to a quantity of fuel.
explanation.definitionFit: Lignite is a soft brown variety of fuel dug from the ground.

clue.text: No dealers sent out such shrubs

indicators.note: sent out suggests the letters of no dealers are dispersed and rearranged

explanation.surface: No traders dispatched these plants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sent out' signals that the letters of NO DEALERS are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Oleanders are evergreen flowering bushes with poisonous leaves.

clue.text: Saw X' getting ahead

parts.note: X is the Roman numeral for ten
getting on means progressing, getting ahead

explanation.surface: Someone noticed a person marked with a cross moving forward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' is the definition by way of the tenon saw, a fine-toothed carpentry saw named after the joint it cuts.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenon saw is the woodworker's tool, so the name stands for that kind of blade.

clue.text: Small, very small, quiet, and clean

parts.note: wee is Scottish for tiny
p, piano, is the musical mark for quiet

explanation.surface: A list of qualities ending with a tidy-up.
explanation.definitionFit: To sweep is to clean a floor with a brush.

clue.text: A course taken in instalments?

parts.note: a meal course eaten bit by bit, splitting the word into a portion and a dinner

explanation.definitionFit: Piecemeal means gradually, bit by bit.

clue.text: Like some heavenly food?

parts.note: describes the quality of the food eaten by the Greek gods

explanation.definitionFit: Ambrosia was the food of the gods, so the adjective describes divinely delicious fare.

clue.text: The person without a carrier selling out

indicators.note: without means outside, the person word around the carrier

parts.note: a being is a person
a tray carries things

explanation.surface: Someone without transport betrays a cause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is the old sense outside: BEING goes around TRAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Betraying means selling out, being disloyal.

clue.text: A tool held by simple men the wrong way

indicators.note: held by means the letters are contained within the words that follow

explanation.surface: An instrument kept by unsophisticated people, used incorrectly.
explanation.walkthrough: The run sits inside 'simple men the', signalled by 'held by'; 'the wrong way' is surface dressing.
explanation.definitionFit: An implement is an instrument or utensil used for work.

clue.text: In and out of play — it's not right

parts.note: taken as written
ex means out of, from
an act is part of a play, a performance

explanation.surface: A ball in and out of play is wrongly called.
explanation.definitionFit: Inexact means imprecise, not correct.

clue.text: Mean to grab share

parts.note: par is an average, a mean
take means grab

explanation.surface: A stingy person trying to seize a portion.
explanation.definitionFit: To partake is to participate or have a portion.

clue.text: Spoke about little page being most pleasant

indicators.note: about means the word for spoke goes around the page letter

parts.note: said means spoke
P is the short form of page

explanation.surface: Someone talked about a young page who was very agreeable.
explanation.definitionFit: Sapid means savoury, agreeable to the taste.

clue.text: Guarantee cash and honour in advance

parts.note: P, penny or pence, is cash

indicators.note: in puts the honour inside the advance word

parts.note: a rise is an advance, as in pay
OM, Order of Merit, is an honour

explanation.surface: A pledge of money and an award paid ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts OM (Order of Merit) inside RISE.
explanation.definitionFit: A promise is a pledge or assurance.

clue.text: Turn aside to poke about craft

parts.note: dig means poke
re means about, concerning
SS, steamship, is a craft

explanation.surface: Someone turns away to prod around a boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To digress is to wander from the main subject.

clue.text: Just the home for young high-fliers!

definitions.text: Just the home for young high-fliers!

parts.words: Just the home for young high-fliers!
parts.note: the high-fliers are birds of prey, and their young live in a lofty nest

explanation.definitionFit: An eyrie is an eagle's nest built high on a crag.

clue.text: Lay on unpretentious music in church

indicators.note: on means the lay comes after the word for unpretentious

parts.note: plain means unpretentious
a lay is a song or ballad

explanation.surface: Someone stages simple music in a church.
explanation.definitionFit: Plainsong is unaccompanied liturgical chant, such as Gregorian chant.

clue.text: To hit back is capital!

indicators.note: back means the hitting word is reversed

parts.note: to rap is to hit

explanation.surface: Retaliating is excellent!
explanation.walkthrough: 'back' turns RAP into PAR; 'capital' is a city, not the exclamation 'excellent'.
explanation.definitionFit: Paris is the French capital city.

clue.text: Arrests scores

definitions.meaning: to nick is British slang for to arrest

explanation.definitionFit: Police nick criminals; notches or scratches are also nicks.

clue.text: A graduate with true potential, but no expert

parts.note: an MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate

indicators.note: potential suggests the letters of true could become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: A promising graduate is still a novice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'potential' signals that TRUE is rearranged into TEUR.
explanation.definitionFit: An amateur is a non-professional, a dabbler.

clue.text: Heel getting into many a row

parts.note: in means into
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, many
a line is a row

explanation.surface: A scoundrel joins a long queue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heel' is not the cad but the verb a ship does when it leans over.
explanation.definitionFit: To heel is to lean or tilt, as a ship does in the wind.

clue.text: Climbers may well find support here

definitions.text: Climbers may well find support here

parts.words: Climbers may well find support here
parts.note: the climbers are climbing plants, not mountaineers, and they grow up a lattice frame

explanation.definitionFit: A trellis is a lattice framework for training plants up a wall.

clue.text: Note guides can be ebullient individuals

parts.note: G is a musical note
ushers guide people to their seats

explanation.surface: Tour guides can be bubbly people.
explanation.definitionFit: Gushers are effusive people who talk with excessive enthusiasm.
